newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Xinjiang Tebian plans A share offer.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinjiang Tebian plans A share offer.

text.p: Xinjiang Tebian Electrical Engineering Co Ltd plans to apply to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an offer of 40 million domestic A shares this year, a company official said on Tuesday.
CITIC Securities Co Ltd would be named as lead underwriter for the offer, which has been tentatively priced at 5.0 yuan per share, he told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter.

The company, which makes transformers, wire and cable for power plants, has not decided where to apply to list the stock, the official said. If successful, Tebian would use the proceeds to expand its operations, he said.
Tebian has a total share capital of 51.68 million shares, comprising 48.68 million legal person shares and three million staff shares.
Tebian, based in the city of Changji in the northwestern Xinjiang region, estimated 1996 net profits at more than 18 million yuan, compared with 6.0 million yuan in 1995 and 5.0 million yuan in 1994.
The official said the surge in earnings last year was due to the company's success in taking over a local competitor, which resulted in a sharp expansion in its core business.
